source: percia-cf docs/specs/cameras/camera-push-api.md and ADR 0042 (branch divi-vijayakumar/camera-push-api, caa8b4c), recorded 2026-11-14. Shared by the TypeScript, Python and CLI tests. Tokens here are fakes.
assumptions: POST /api/cameras with kind:'push' answers 201 {camera, whipUrl, token, expiresAt:null, publish} and, for a known (user, externalId), 200 {camera, whipUrl, token:null, existing:true}.
POST /api/cameras/:id/token answers 200 {token, whipUrl, expiresAt:null}; DELETE answers 200; a phone camera answers 409 wrong_kind.
There is no GET /api/cameras/:id/status route and no bulk route (the spec lists bulk create as a non-goal): the SDKs derive status from GET /api/cameras and bulk from registerPush.
ffmpeg's whip muxer takes the publish token with -authorization (a Bearer token); heartbeat is POST /api/cam/heartbeat with Authorization: Bearer <camera token>, every 20 s.
